svg.title: Top-down ranch map where git branches are cattle trails leading to a merge-queue corral
svg.desc: A map-style illustration. A thick main trail runs along the bottom. Dashed feature-branch trails leave it and converge on a circular fenced corral labeled Merge Queue, with top-down bulls tagged with PR numbers travelling along them. A chute exits the corral back down onto main at a merge commit. A compass rose and legend sit in the top-left.
